issues.problem: Rule-sanctioned residual, not documented as one: bracketed numbers that are content are stripped like citation markers, so a changed index/value reaches supported.
issues.evidence: attack10.py: 'Use arr[1] for the header.' <= 'Use arr[0] for the header.' supported; 'The interval is [6].' <= '[5]' supported; 'The range is [2, 9].' <= '[1, 5]' supported; attack9 'Revenue rose 5% in.' <= 'Revenue rose 5% in [2023].' supported. Inherent to the binding rule '[n] after a space or non-digit is ignored'.
issues.suggested_fix: Name it in quality-gates.md as an accepted residual (bracketed numbers are read as citations), next to Polish/polish.

issues.problem: Only negative contractions (n't, cannot) are expanded; the docs say 'a contraction'. it's/we're/I'll are not expanded (stricter: honest 'It is free.' <= "It's free." is needs_review). The n't rule also fires inside odd words ("ain't"->'ai not', "shan't"->'sha not', "pecan't"->'peca not') and 'can not only' = 'cannot only'; only gibberish or rule-allowed claims reach supported. No expansion creates or hides a negation: won't/wont, can't/cant, it's/its, I'll/ill, we're/were, doesn't/does, isn't/is, can't not/can all needs_review or contradicted.
issues.suggested_fix: Say 'a negative contraction (n't, cannot)' in the docs and docstring.

issues.problem: Short sentences (<=30 chars) without a checkable figure or a name are not extracted, so they are never checked at all.
issues.evidence: Report lines 'The board is 6" wide [1].', 'The tool is not free [1].', 'x != 0 is required [1].' -> claims.jsonl has 0 rows (REVF-H8a10-probe/runs/x1, e-inch first attempt); a longer version of each is extracted and checked.
issues.suggested_fix: Out of scope for this round; consider extracting every cited sentence.
